summary: CGI Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its annual MD&A, audited consolidated financial statements for fiscal years ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, a results press release dated November 11, 2026, and PricewaterhouseCoopers' auditor consent. This is a routine foreign private issuer annual reporting package, the US-equivalent of an annual report/earnings release, not a special situation. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. Nothing for a risk-arb angle; watch ordinary operating results and guidance.
